title: Vehicle Value Reduction of the Voluntary Surrender Fee (Repossession and Collateral Recovery)
content:
Pricing schedule for the surrender value reduction under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, read from the vehicle book value recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts.

**Rule.** Where the contract's vehicle book value is below 6000.00, the surrender value reduction is the amount by which the standard voluntary surrender fee (the collateral class's voluntary surrender fee) exceeds 2 percent of that book value (that percentage figure rounded to the cent), and never less than zero; where the book value is at least 6000.00 but below 10000.00, the surrender value reduction is 1.5 percent of the amount by which the book value falls short of 10000.00, rounded to the cent; where the book value is 10000.00 or more, there is no surrender value reduction.

## Worked bands (hypothetical standard surrender fee of 1,000.00)

1. Book value 4000.00: 2 percent is 80.00; the reduction is 1,000.00 less 80.00, that is 920.00.
2. Book value 5999.99: 2 percent is 119.9998, rounded to 120.00; the reduction is 880.00.
3. Book value 6000.00: the shortfall below 10000.00 is 4000.00; 1.5 percent of it is 60.00.
4. Book value 9000.00: the shortfall is 1,000.00; the reduction is 15.00.
5. Book value 10000.00: no surrender value reduction.

With a hypothetical standard surrender fee of 100.00 and a book value of 5500.00, 2 percent is 110.00, more than the fee, so the reduction is zero.

| Book value | Reduction |
|---|---|
| under 6000.00 | fee less 2 percent of book value, not below zero |
| 6000.00 to under 10000.00 | 1.5 percent of the shortfall below 10000.00 |
| 10000.00 and over | none |
